page_title: REN 3-1 BRE | Rennes v Brest 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Brice Samba (Rennes) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' Neat passing move from Brest in order to create new attacking opportunities.
88' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Romain Del Castillo will be replaced by Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daouda Guindo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Bradley Locko (Brest).

87' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Mohamed Meite (Rennes) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Quentin Merlin. The score is 3:1.
86' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
86' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) picks up a long through ball, but Brice Samba deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
84' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
82' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) replaces Kamory Doumbia.
81' Substitution. Lucas Tousart (Brest) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hugo Magnetti walks off.
79' Substitution. Alidu Seidu (Rennes) in, Mousa Tamari out.
79' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Seko Fofana (Rennes) replacing Breel Embolo.
78' The game has come to an end for Esteban Lepaul. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed Meite (Rennes).
77' Brest control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
74' The possession of the ball – 59:41.
71' An accurate cross finds its way to Kamory Doumbia (Brest) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) will replace Mama Balde.
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benoit Millot blows for a foul. A free kick to Brest.
64' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
61' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

59' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
59' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
58' The free kick from long range, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' A substitution has been made. Djaoui Cisse goes off and Ludovic Blas (Rennes) comes on.
57' 59:41 – the latest ball possession ratio.
55' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Brest are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
51' The substitution is prepared. Quentin Merlin (Rennes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Przemyslaw Frankowski.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brest.
48' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Millot had a clear view and blows his whistle.
46' Brest couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Brice Samba (Rennes) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

46' The game is interrupted. Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. That's a free kick to Brest.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

40' Brest slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
37' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
33' 58:42 – the ratio of ball possession.
29' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Mousa Tamari (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
29' Rennes take a short corner kick.

29' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Gregoire Coudert sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Rennes earn a corner.
27' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
25' 2 - 1 Mousa Tamari (Rennes) becomes the centre of attention as he finishes a great individual effort with a nice goal. His low shot ended up inside the left post.
24' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Mousa Tamari laid the ball off to Esteban Lepaul (Rennes), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Wonderful movement by Rennes. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
17' Mama Balde (Brest) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
16' The Brest players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
15' Pathe Mboup (Brest) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Kamory Doumbia plays a pass to the feet of Mama Balde (Brest), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 0:1.
11' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The ball is out of play. Brest will have a chance to score from a corner.
1' Mama Balde (Brest) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Rennes will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot was nominated as the referee for this game.
